newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Veronica raises share of Dutch TV audience in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Veronica raises share of Dutch TV audience in Nov.

text.p: Veronica, which left the Dutch public broadcasting system in 1995 to become a commercial broadcaster, raised its share of the Dutch television audience to 10 percent in November from eight in October.
The NOS audience research unit published the following Dutch television viewing figures for November:
Channel Audience share in pct: Nov 96 Oct 96 Nov 95

NOTES - NL1, NL2 and NL3 are public channels. RTL4, RTL5, Veronica, SBS and Sport7 are commercial channels. Arcade figures are combined total for its TV10 and Music Factory channels. OWNERSHIP DETAILS:
RTL4 and RTL5 -- Dutch publisher VNU owns 38 pct of both channels, Luxembourg-based CLT owns 61 pct of both.
SBS6 -- Scandinavian Broadcasting System owns 70 pct of SBS6, Dutch publisher De Telegraaf 30 percent.
TV10 and Music Factory -- Both channels are wholly owned units of Dutch media group Wegener Arcade.

Sport7 -- PTT Nederland, ING, Philips Electronics and Dutch TV production firm Endemol each own 19.5 percent stakes in Sport7. Dutch soccer association KNVB has a 10 percent stake and De Telegraaf five percent.
Veronica -- Left the public broadcasting system in 1995 to become a commercial station.
